description: PySCF DF-RHF CPHF over this tree's data/basis and data/aux_basis files, spherical: the orbitals, orbital energies (hartree), the nuclear-displacement right-hand sides and pyscf.df.hessian.rhf solve_mo1's vo block, and the dipole right-hand sides and static polarizability (bohr^3). Each right-hand side and solution is (n_vir n_occ) x ncol, element a + n_vir i of column x. Arrays are '<f8' Fortran-order .npy files beside this one
